Name: AmazonBasics Wicker Planter with Trellis - Black, 27.5" x 8.67" x 31.5" (Renewed)
Colors: Black
Materials: Resin
Resin wicker planter box with trellis for growing vine plants; for outdoor use Rust-resistant powder-coated steel frame Crack-resistant wicker offers all-weather durability Removable trellis folds flat for easy storage Hard plastic liners that can be removed for easy filling Predrilled drain holes allow for controlled drainage and prevent water logging of the plant roots Dimensions: 27.5 x 9.6 x 33 inches
